messages:
morgan_sales: kicking off POC with NexGenMed — streaming keeps hanging after ~30s when going through their corporate proxy. Customer sees ECONNRESET and then long reconnect loops.
alex_eng: do we have logs or a repro? can you paste client debug output (node/python) and the proxy vendor?
jamie_se: they mentioned "BlueGate" proxy and an Azure AD token refresh flow for service-to-service auth. might be a kept-alive connection getting closed by the proxy.
morgan_sales: attaching the snippets they pasted: 
```
Node error: ECONNRESET at TLSWrap.onread (net.js:715)
Request headers: {
  "Authorization": "Bearer <redacted>",
  "Connection": "keep-alive"
}
```
clair_security: also they raised a security questionnaire item asking about KMS integration and key residency — will need a short blurb for their security team.
alex_eng: for the connection issue first things: ask them to try explicit socket keepalive and increase TLS socket timeout. For Node/TS: 
```
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 10000 });
fetch(url, { agent, timeout: 60000 });
```
jamie_se: for Python requests/urllib3: set `pool_maxsize` and `socket_options` or use `timeout=(connect, read)` on streaming calls. example: `client.stream(..., timeout=(5, 300))`.
morgan_sales: they also reported bursts of 429s right after reconnects. could that be our rate-limit + their retry storm?
alex_eng: yes, reconnect storm can trigger per-customer token rate limits. ask them to back off on client retries (exponential with jitter) and to honor Retry-After header. we should also check their token refresh timing — Azure AD can return 401 if clock skew or invalid refresh token.
clair_security: for the questionnaire I'll provide KMS/HSM answers: "customer-managed keys supported via KMS integration; data plane keys never leave region when Private deployment; audit logs available." I'll send copy.
jamie_se: repro command you can ask them to run (curl) to show low-level behavior: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate
```
morgan_sales: tried that — curl connection stays open then proxy returns `502 Bad Gateway` after 28s.
alex_eng: that strongly indicates proxy idle timeout. short-term fix: set smaller heartbeats/ping frames from client or enable chunked keepalive on proxy. Long-term: recommend dedicated or private deployment to avoid corporate proxy for streaming.
jamie_se: I'll draft a customer-facing note: 1) reduce client retry aggressiveness, 2) enable keepAlive on SDK, 3) honor Retry-After, 4) run curl repro and capture tcpdump.
morgan_sales: perfect. I'll share the curl command + ask for their proxy config and the Azure AD token exchange logs. Also forwarding Clair's KMS blurb and pricing note for reserved capacity if they want to avoid proxy path. :thumbsup:
